overview_description.description: Fabius is a platform that uses sales and customer data to support go-to-market activities. The system collects information from calls, emails, documents, training materials, and marketing content. It identifies buying signals, proof points, and common questions from prospects to guide sales teams. Fabius provides pre-call research by analyzing a prospect’s website and related materials. After calls, the platform generates follow-up emails and updates customer records in the CRM. It also creates rubrics for discovery and selling, scores sales representatives, and gives feedback on areas to work on. The platform can be used across the sales process, including prospecting, meetings, ongoing deals, and post-sale activities.

product.name: Fabius Sales Intelligence Platform
product.description: A platform that analyzes sales calls, emails, and documents using AI to provide insights tailored to a company's unique sales process and product.

product.name: Pre-Call Research Tool
product.description: Analyzes prospect websites and related content to provide sales reps with tailored insights for discovery calls.

product.name: Post-Call Automation
product.description: Automatically generates personalized follow-up emails and updates CRM records after sales calls.

product.name: Sales Feedback and Coaching Module
product.description: Scores sales reps on specific behaviors using custom rubrics and provides targeted improvement recommendations.

product.name: Gong Integration
product.description: An integration that connects Fabius with Gong to leverage Gong's call recordings and data for enhanced sales analysis.
